{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = data.duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate rows: {duplicates}')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = data.isnull().sum()
print('\nMissing values per column:\n', missing_values)

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
sentinel_values = data[['biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final']].apply(lambda x: (x == -999).sum())
print('\nSentinel value (-999) counts:\n', sentinel_values)"}
